SALE OF TWO STOREY THREE BEDROOM SEMI DETACHED DWELLINGHOUSE WITH PRIVATE GARDEN IN CENTRAL LOCATION.

Situated in Westbury Woods in a well-established residential area of Enniscorthy town within close proximity to all supermarkets, Dunnes Stores, Pettitts, schools and four-star hotel and many historical sites, Enniscorthy is steeped in history, Vinegar Hill the most famous site of the 1798 rebellion. The property comes to the market in first class condition throughout, with no outlay having been well maintained by the present owners.
Lovely light filled family home with the benefit of nice private sunny garden.
